paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: We compare error rate (one minus accuracy), computation cost, and memory usage across our approach and baselines when fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks. MTL-FT refers to first fine-tuning a shared LoRA on all the datasets, and then fine-tuning the low-rank adapter on each dataset, while Full FT refers to full fine-tuning of the entire model. Our approach boosts the test accuracy of QLoRA by 10\% on average, only incurring 8\% additional computation and 9 GB more memory. It performs on par with the best baseline with 45\% less FLOPs.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира изчислителната цена в FLOPs на различни методи за фина настройка на езикови модели. 
Хоризонталната ос показва категориите на методите: Full FT, TAG, LoRA, MTL-FT, QLoRA и Ours. 
Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като # FLoPs и показва стойностите на изчислителната цена във FLoPs на логаритмична скала от $10^{18}$ до $10^{20}$. 
Всеки метод е представен със стълб, като повечето са в оранжев цвят, а последният е в зелен цвят. 
Стойностите на FLOPs са както следва: Full FT е около $9.5 \times 10^{19}$, TAG е около $8.5 \times 10^{19}$, LoRA е около $5.5 \times 10^{19}$, MTL-FT е около $3.5 \times 10^{19}$, QLoRA е около $2.5 \times 10^{19}$ и Ours е около $2.0 \times 10^{19}$. 
Няма допълнително групиране или наслагване на стълбите, а стълбите не са подредени в определен ред освен според етикетите на хоризонталната ос. 
Някои стълби нямат допълнителни визуални акценти.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the comparison of FLOPs across different fine-tuning methods for Llama-3-8B on NLP tasks. The horizontal axis lists six categories: Full FT, TAG, LoRA, MTL-FT, QLoRA, and Ours, which represent various fine-tuning approaches. The vertical axis on the left side is labeled "# FLOPs" and has a logarithmic scale ranging from $10^{18}$ to $10^{20}$. The orange bars represent FLOPs for Full FT, TAG, LoRA, MTL-FT, and QLoRA, with approximate values of $9.5 \times 10^{19}$, $8.5 \times 10^{19}$, $6.0 \times 10^{19}$, $3.0 \times 10^{19}$, and $1.8 \times 10^{19}$, respectively. The green bar represents FLOPs for Ours, with an approximate value of $3.0 \times 10^{18}$. The bars are arranged in descending order of their heights. No specific visual emphasis is applied to any of the bars.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt einen Vergleich der Rechenleistung verschiedener Methoden zur Anpassung von Sprachmodellen, gemessen in FLOPs (Floating Point Operations). Die horizontale Achse listet die Methoden auf, darunter "Full FT", "TAG", "LoRA", "MTL-FT", "QLoRA" und "Ours", in dieser Reihenfolge von links nach rechts, ohne besondere Sortierung oder Hervorhebung. Die vertikale Achse stellt die Anzahl der FLOPs dar, skaliert in Potenzen von 10, von $10^{18}$ bis $10^{20}$. Die Balken sind wie folgt: Der höchste Balken, der "Full FT" zugeordnet ist, erreicht fast $10^{20}$ FLOPs, während "TAG" und "LoRA" etwas darunter liegen, bei ungefähr $9 \cdot  10^{19}$ beziehungsweise $7 \cdot 10^{19}$ FLOPs. "MTL-FT" liegt bei etwa $4 \cdot 10^{19}$ FLOPs, "QLoRA" darunter bei ungefähr $2 \cdot 10^{19}$ FLOPs. Der niedrigste Balken, "Ours", liegt bei knapp über $10^{19}$ FLOPs. Die Balken sind orange gefärbt, außer dem für "Ours", der grün ist.
